topic: Bruno spins round and round trying to catch his own tail; Mishi teaches him to slow down and be patient.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: The Tail Chase

shots.narration: Bruno’s tail was right there—why couldn’t he catch it?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy colourful living room, round yellow rug, soft warm light, rounded 3D family-film style, no text.
shots.action: Bruno turns in a circle after his own tail.
shots.mood: Playful curiosity, floppy ears lifted outward.

shots.narration: Around he went, but his tail went too!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, yellow living-room rug beside a soft green armchair, warm sunlight, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Bruno makes another small circle while Mishi watches from the armchair.
shots.mood: Silly determination, Mishi’s bright green eyes following Bruno.

shots.narration: [chuckles] That sneaky tail stayed one wiggle ahead.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of Bruno on the yellow rug, cosy blurred furniture, warm 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Bruno turns his head toward his tail.
shots.mood: Comic puzzlement, raised eyebrows and a tilted floppy ear.

shots.narration: Mishi knew her friend needed a little pause.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, living-room rug beside the green armchair, soft golden light, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mishi steps onto the rug beside Bruno.
shots.mood: Gentle concern, friendly faces and relaxed ears.

shots.narration: She showed him one slow, careful step.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, yellow rug at paw level, colourful cushions behind, warm 3D family-film style, no text.
shots.action: Mishi takes one deliberate step in front of the stationary Bruno.
shots.mood: Quiet concentration, Bruno watching Mishi’s paw.

shots.narration: [whispers] Then Mishi settled down, without any hurry.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunlit living-room rug, soft green armchair behind, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mishi slowly lowers herself into a seated position.
shots.mood: Peaceful patience, soft eyes and loose shoulders.

shots.narration: Bruno decided to try her quiet way.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, yellow rug beside an open garden doorway, warm 3D animation, no text.

shots.narration: His tail curled right beside his paws.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of seated Bruno’s paws on the yellow rug, soft warm lighting, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Bruno’s tail relaxes into view beside his front paws.
shots.mood: A quiet discovery, Bruno’s eyes widening gently.

shots.narration: [surprised] Oh! There it was, without another chase.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, seated Bruno on the sunny yellow rug, cosy colourful room, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Bruno gently touches his tail with one front paw.
shots.mood: Delighted surprise, bright eyes and a happy open smile.

shots.narration: Bruno thanked Mishi with a happy little nuzzle.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, two friends seated beside the garden doorway, warm golden light, rounded 3D family-film style, no text.
shots.mood: Affectionate delight, Mishi’s eyes softly closed.

shots.narration: Outside, a little ball began rolling down the garden slope.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny enclosed garden, gently sloping lawn, flower beds and a plain red ball, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: The red ball rolls slowly down the grassy slope.
shots.mood: Inviting curiosity, bright flowers and soft sunshine.

shots.narration: [excited] Be patient—next, where will that rolling ball lead?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, open doorway overlooking the enclosed sunny garden, red ball visible on the lawn, warm 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mishi points one paw toward the garden ball.
shots.mood: Eager anticipation, Bruno sitting attentively beside his best friend.

episode.endHook: Where will that rolling garden ball lead them?
episode.description: Bruno’s tail is always one wiggle ahead! Mishi helps her best friend slow down and discover what a little patience can do.
